new comment 5089620 (near Minerva lakópark, Szombathely) / Created 11 months ago by toboz
In context of overlay "Things" – Bus Stop – https://osm.org/node/12465988116 via StreetComplete 62.0: Ez a megálló megszűnt? Ellenőrizni kellene Attached photo(s): https://streetcomplete.app/p/319925.jpg / Updated about 4 hours ago by SzilágyiGyula
Hi! Checked on-site / via Street View, the bus stop is definitely still there (with the stop sign and infrastructure intact). It should remain on the map. / Updated 28 minutes ago by toboz
Street View isn't really a reliable source in this case. Even if we consider it usable (which is not the case), the imagery is 14 years old here. The local bus network has undergone several changes since then, particularly after Blaguss took over Szombathely's local bus services in 2022. Based on the photo I took on-site, it seemed to me that this was a bus stop in the past, but is no longer in use. The former bus bay now appears to be used for parking. It's possible that the stop was discontinued as part of the network changes introduced by Blaguss, but I can't confirm that. It would be helpful if a mapper with sufficient local knowledge could verify whether this stop is actually still in service.

new comment 5388097 (near Felszabadulás MTSZ, Picktelep, Szombathely) / Created 4 months ago by Mateusz Konieczny
https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/1024790371/history place=farm wiki page ( https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:place=farm ) claims that it is solely for named farms. Is this tagged incorrectly? Is it named but name is missing from OSM? Is wiki wrong? / Updated about 4 hours ago by SzilágyiGyula
Hi Mateusz, Thanks for pointing this out! This location is actually a local agricultural cooperative site (TSZ / farmyard) known as Szombathelyi Felszabadulás Mgsz (Mezőgazdasági Szövetkezet). It is an active agricultural/industrial farm compound rather than a standalone named hamlet or named residential farm, so the place=farm tag without a name is indeed inappropriate here. Feel free to update it to landuse=farmyard (or building=farm_auxiliary) and add name=Szombathelyi Felszabadulás Mgsz. / Updated about 2 hours ago by Mateusz Konieczny
https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/548718420 farmyard area is present already
